title: Mission 04: The Relocation
story: The department is moving from office_old to office_new, and you are the moving crew. Some things get copied, some get moved, one gets renamed on the spot, and nothing gets lost. cp duplicates; mv relocates; the difference is the whole job.

badge.name: The Relocation: Moved In
badge.desc: Mastered cp and mv by relocating an office without losing a byte.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING4.txt in your department directory. The master list must exist in BOTH offices: copy office_old/master_list.txt into office_new/ so the original stays where it is.

checks.fail: office_new/master_list.txt does not exist yet.
The ORIGINAL office_old/master_list.txt is gone. This job called for a copy, not a move.
The copy's content does not match the master list.

tasks.brief: The proposal belongs ONLY in the new office. Move office_old/drafts/proposal.txt into office_new/ so it no longer exists in the old drafts.

checks.fail: office_new/proposal.txt has not arrived yet.
proposal.txt still exists in office_old/drafts. A move leaves nothing behind.
proposal.txt arrived damaged; its content changed in transit.

tasks.brief: Someone saved 'report_finel.txt' in office_old. Fix the filename to report_final.txt WITHOUT relocating it (same directory, new name).

checks.fail: office_old/report_final.txt does not exist yet.
The misspelled report_finel.txt is still there. mv renames when source and destination share a directory.
The renamed report's content changed. Renaming must not touch content.

tasks.brief: The assets directory moves as a COPY: duplicate office_old/assets (the directory and everything inside, subfolders included) into office_new/assets.

checks.fail: office_new/assets (with its branding subfolder) does not exist yet. Copying a directory takes one extra option.
The nested branding file did not survive the copy intact.
office_old/assets is gone. This was a copy job; the original stays until the audit clears.

tasks.brief: Legal needs ledger.csv copied to office_new WITH its original modification time preserved (the timestamp is evidence). cp can preserve attributes if you ask it to.

checks.fail: office_new/ledger.csv does not exist yet.
The copy exists but its modification time differs from the original. Plain cp resets timestamps; there is an option that preserves them.

tasks.brief: Both offices have a config.ini and they differ. The NEW office's version wins, but keep the old office's version alongside it as config.ini.bak. End state in office_new: config.ini (new content) AND config.ini.bak (old content).

checks.fail: office_new/config.ini must remain the NEW office's version.
config.ini.bak must hold the OLD office's version, byte for byte.

tasks.brief: Every .log file scattered in office_old's top level moves to office_new/logs/ in one sweep (shell wildcards make this one command). None may remain behind.

checks.fail: office_new/logs/ does not contain all the log files yet.
Log files still remain in office_old's top level. A move leaves nothing behind.
access_1.log arrived damaged.
The old office structure was demolished. The lease says it stands until the audit clears.

tasks.brief: BONUS: preserve the whole remaining office_old as office_archive, everything intact INCLUDING timestamps and permissions (cp has an archive-grade option). ledger.csv's timestamp in the archive must match the original's.

checks.fail: office_archive must contain the remaining old office with timestamps preserved (archive mode).
